requirements: R1: The backend container must start successfully without port allocation failures.

slices.title: Fix backend container port conflict
slices.jtbd: When implementing the Docker compose fix for this epic, I want to remove or alter conflicting port bindings, so that the container starts reliably without 'port is already allocated' errors
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given a clean Docker environment, When docker compose up is executed, Then the backend container starts and binds its ports without error
Given the system is running, When the health endpoint is polled, Then it returns a healthy status
